passages.title: Email: parking policy
passages.body:
To: All employees
From: Facilities Office
Date: September 3
Subject: New parking arrangements

Beginning October 1, the east parking lot will be closed for resurfacing. Employees who normally park there may use the west lot or the garage on Pine Street, which the company has rented for the next three months. A free shuttle will run between the garage and the main entrance every ten minutes from 7:30 A.M. to 9:30 A.M. and from 4:30 P.M. to 6:30 P.M.

Parking permits issued for the east lot remain valid and do not need to be replaced. Employees who prefer to cycle can register for a secure bicycle space with the Facilities Office by September 20.

passages.title: Advertisement: fitness club
passages.body:
PEAKFIT GYM — GRAND OPENING OFFER

PeakFit, the newest fitness club in Westbrook, opens its doors on March 1! Join before March 15 and enjoy:
• No joining fee (a savings of $60)
• Your first month at half price
• A free personal training session with a certified coach

Our facility offers more than 80 machines, a heated pool and group classes from 6 A.M. to 9 P.M. daily. Corporate memberships are available for companies with ten or more employees, with an additional 15 percent discount. Visit peakfit.example or stop by 22 Mill Road to take a tour.

passages.title: Article: bakery expansion
passages.body:
LOCAL BAKERY TO OPEN SECOND SHOP

WESTBROOK (June 12) — Golden Crust Bakery, a family business founded in 2009, announced Tuesday that it will open a second shop on Harper Avenue in August. Owner Teresa Vaughn said the decision followed a three-year period of steady growth. "We have outgrown the original kitchen," she said. "The new location will let us bake twice as much bread and add a small café."

The company will hire eight employees, including two pastry chefs, and has already received more than fifty applications. Ms. Vaughn added that the original shop on Elm Street will remain open and will keep its current hours.

passages.title: Memo: expense policy
passages.body:
MEMO

To: Sales team
From: Priya Nair, Finance Manager
Date: April 4
Re: Updated expense procedures

Effective May 1, all travel expenses must be submitted through the online portal instead of by paper form. Receipts must be uploaded as images within 14 days of the end of the trip. Meal expenses above $50 per day will require approval from a department head before reimbursement.

Training sessions on the portal will be held on April 16 and April 18 at 2:00 P.M. in Room B. Attendance is strongly encouraged, as late or incomplete reports will no longer be reimbursed after June 1.

passages.title: Letter: response to a complaint
passages.body:
Dear Mr. Fischer,

Thank you for your letter of May 6 regarding your recent stay at the Lakeview Hotel. We are sorry that the air conditioning in Room 214 did not work properly and that your request for a different room could not be met because the hotel was full. Our maintenance team has now repaired the unit.

As an apology, we are enclosing a voucher for one free night, valid for any weekday stay before December 31. Please present the voucher when you make your reservation. We hope to welcome you again soon.

Sincerely,
Laura Benson
Guest Relations Manager

passages.title: Job posting
passages.body:
WANTED: Customer Service Representative — Brook & Hale Insurance

Brook & Hale Insurance is hiring a full-time customer service representative for its Denver office. The successful candidate will answer client questions by phone and email, process claims and update records.

Requirements: at least one year of experience in customer service, strong communication skills and basic computer knowledge. Experience in the insurance industry is preferred but not required. Paid training will be provided during the first month.

To apply, send a résumé and cover letter to jobs@brookhale.example by July 10. Interviews will be held the week of July 15.

passages.title: Product recall notice
passages.body:
SAFETY NOTICE — Voluntary recall of the Brightline 12-cup coffee maker, Model BL-12

Zenith Home Products is recalling about 8,000 Brightline coffee makers sold between January and April because the heating element may overheat. No injuries have been reported. Consumers should stop using the product immediately and unplug it.

To receive a full refund or a replacement unit, visit zenithhome.example/recall or call 1-800-555-0148, Monday to Friday, 8 A.M. to 6 P.M. Proof of purchase is not required, but the model number printed on the bottom of the unit must be provided.

passages.title: Press release: new director
passages.body:
FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE

Hartwell Museum names Elena Marchetti as new director

HARTWELL (October 9) — The board of the Hartwell Museum announced today that Elena Marchetti will become its next director on January 2, succeeding Paul Okafor, who retires after twelve years. Ms. Marchetti currently serves as head curator at the Riverside Gallery, where she organized the award-winning exhibit "Light and Glass." "Elena's vision and experience make her an excellent choice," said board chair Daniel Reyes.

COMMUNITY GARDEN TO OPEN IN SPRING

RIVERDALE — The city council has approved a community garden on Birch Street, on land donated by the Alston family. Sixty plots will be available. Residents of Riverdale may apply starting February 1. Each plot will be assigned by lottery on March 1 for a yearly fee of $40. Tools and water will be provided.

- - - - - - - - - -

RIVERDALE COMMUNITY GARDEN — APPLICATION

Name: Anil Desai
Address: 14 Maple Road, Riverdale
Plot size: ☑ Small (3x3 m)  ☐ Large (3x6 m)
Experience: ☐ Beginner  ☑ Experienced
I agree to pay the fee within seven days of receiving a plot: ☑
Submitted: February 6

- - - - - - - - - -

To: Anil Desai
From: Garden Committee
Date: March 3
Subject: Plot assignment

Dear Mr. Desai,

Congratulations! You have been assigned Plot 17. Please pay the $40 fee by March 10 and attend the orientation on March 15 at 9:00 A.M. Gardening begins March 22.
